from solution import zip_tuples
import inspect


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example zip_tuples((7,8,4,5,9,10),(1,5,6)) equals [(7,1),(8,5),(4,6),(5,1),(9,5),(10,6)]."""
    # indices: 0%3=0, 1%3=1, 2%3=2, 3%3=0, 4%3=1, 5%3=2
    assert zip_tuples((7, 8, 4, 5, 9, 10), (1, 5, 6)) == [(7, 1), (8, 5), (4, 6), (5, 1), (9, 5), (10, 6)]


def test_issue_even_cycle():
    """Zip cycles second tuple when first length is an even multiple of second."""
    # indices: 0%2=0, 1%2=1, 2%2=0, 3%2=1
    assert zip_tuples((1, 2, 3, 4), (10, 20)) == [(1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 10), (4, 20)]


def test_issue_remainder_cycle():
    """Zip cycles second tuple with remainder when lengths do not divide evenly."""
    # indices: 0%3=0, 1%3=1, 2%3=2, 3%3=0, 4%3=1
    assert zip_tuples((1, 2, 3, 4, 5), (10, 20, 30)) == [(1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30), (4, 10), (5, 20)]


def test_issue_single_element_second():
    """Zip repeats the single second element for every first element."""
    # indices: 0%1=0, 1%1=0, 2%1=0
    assert zip_tuples((7, 8, 9), (0,)) == [(7, 0), (8, 0), (9, 0)]


def test_issue_equal_lengths():
    """Zip pairs element-wise with no cycling when tuples have equal length."""
    # indices: 0%3=0, 1%3=1, 2%3=2
    assert zip_tuples((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6)) == [(1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)]


def test_issue_single_pair():
    """Zip of single-element tuples returns one pair."""
    # indices: 0%1=0 so (42, 99)
    assert zip_tuples((42,), (99,)) == [(42, 99)]


def test_issue_both_empty():
    """Zip of two empty tuples is an empty list."""
    # lengths: 0 + 0 = 0 pairs
    assert zip_tuples((), ()) == []


def test_issue_first_empty():
    """Zip with empty first tuple returns empty list."""
    # length of first is 0 so 0 pairs: 0 == 0
    assert zip_tuples((), (1, 2, 3)) == []


def test_issue_string_elements_cycle():
    """Zip works for non-int elements by cycling second tuple."""
    # indices: 0%2=0, 1%2=1, 2%2=0
    assert zip_tuples(("a", "b", "c"), (1, 2)) == [("a", 1), ("b", 2), ("c", 1)]


def test_contract_result_is_list_of_tuples():
    """Example shows the result is a list of tuples."""
    # indices: 0%2=0, 1%2=1 so 2 pairs: 1+1=2
    result = zip_tuples((1, 2), (3, 4))
    assert result == [(1, 3), (2, 4)]
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert all(isinstance(p, tuple) and len(p) == 2 for p in result)


def test_contract_takes_two_arguments():
    """zip_tuples(test_tup1, test_tup2) takes two arguments."""
    # expected arity 2: 1+1=2
    sig = inspect.signature(zip_tuples)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 2
